item.title: 1979 Mercedes-Benz 450SL at No Reserve
item.description: This 1979 Mercedes-Benz 450SL is powered by a 4.5-liter V8 paired with a three-speed automatic transmission, and it has been refinished in red over a beige interior. Equipment includes a removable hardtop, 14" Bundt alloy wheels, fog lights, an aftermarket stereo, electric windows, central locking, and air conditioning. item.title: 1993 Honda Acty Attack Pickup 4WD 4-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 1993 Honda Acty Attack is a right-hand-drive 4WD pickup that was acquired by the selling dealer in Japan and imported to the US in 2025. It now shows 110k kilometers (~68k miles) and is powered by a 656cc E07A inline-three linked with a four-speed manual transaxle, a Real Time four-wheel-drive system, and a locking rear differential. item.title: 47k-Kilometer 1993 Mazda Familia GT-R
item.description: This 1993 Mazda Familia GT-R is a three-door hatchback that was imported from Japan to the US following the selling dealer's acquisition in 2025, and it shows 47k kilometers (~29k miles). Power is provided by a turbocharged and intercooled 1.8-liter DOHC inline-four mated to a five-speed manual transaxle and an all-wheel-drive system with viscous limited-slip differentials. item.title: 2003 Lincoln Town Car Cartier at No Reserve
item.description: This 2003 Lincoln Town Car Cartier was initially delivered to World Lincoln Mercury Snellville in Georgia, and was purchased by the seller from the original owner in 2024. Finished in White Pearlescent Clearcoat Metallic over Light Parchment leather, the car is powered by a 4.6-liter V8 paired with a four-speed automatic transmission. item.title: 12k-Kilometer 2000 Nissan Altima GXE at No Reserve
item.description: This 2000 Nissan Altima was said to have remained under the care of a single family and is said to have been off the road for approximately 20 years. It is powered by a 2.4-liter inline-four paired with a four-speed automatic transaxle and is finished in bronze over beige cloth. Equipment includes 15" steel wheels, a CD stereo, air conditioning, cruise control, and power windows. This Altima is now offered in Canada by the seller on behalf of the current owner with Ontario registration.

item.title: Chevrolet L72 427 V8 Engine at No Reserve
item.description: This 1969 Chevrolet 427ci V8 was purchased by the seller around 2022 and subsequently rebuilt. It is equipped with a "512" block, "391" rectangular-port cylinder heads, a Winters aluminum intake manifold, a Holley four-barrel carburetor, chrome valve covers, and cast iron exhaust manifolds. The engine is now offered at no reserve in Milford, Michigan.
